1.title: Inside Cover - Elijah Muhammad's Signature & Ownership
1.translationMaulana: Dedication and shipment inscription: this Qur'an was sent FROM Mustopa Milham (1559 Central Avenue, Cincinnati, Ohio) TO Elijah Mohammed (6116 South Michigan Avenue, Chicago, Illinois).
1.translationYusuf: The handwritten signature and address of Elijah Muhammad authenticate this as his personal copy of the First Quran given to him by Master Fard Muhammad. This manuscript represents the spiritual foundation upon which the Nation of Islam was built and the guidance the Honorable Elijah Muhammad followed in his ministry to Black America.
1.transliteration: Mustopa Milham / 1559 Central Ave / Cincinnati, Ohio — to — Elijah Mohammed / 6116 S. Michigan Ave. / Chicago, Ill.
1.annotations:
Urdu/Persian script at top of page:
مصطفیٰ محمد درہ

English handwritten text on page:
Mustopa Milham
1559 Central ave
Cincinnati Ohio
to
Elijah Mohammed
6116 S. Michigan Ave.
Chicago ILL.

Handwriting authentication: Elijah Muhammad's signature on this page is CONFIRMED AUTHENTIC. The sender information (Milham name and address) handwriting origin remains PENDING VERIFICATION.

2.title: Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening) - Verse 1 of 7
2.translationMaulana: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
2.translationYusuf: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
2.annotations: The Basmala opens every action in Islamic practice. Ar-Rahman refers to mercy embracing all creation. Ar-Rahim refers to mercy toward believers. This invocation reconnects the believer to divine guidance and establishes that all derives from Allah's mercy.

3.title: Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening) - Verse 2 of 7
3.translationMaulana: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds,
3.translationYusuf: Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds;
3.annotations: Al-Hamdu declares that every commendation and gratitude belongs exclusively to Allah. This verse liberates the Black believer from psychological bondage by establishing that true authority flows only from Allah.

4.title: Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening) - Verse 3 of 7
4.annotations: Ar-Rahman represents universal mercy extended to all creatures. Ar-Rahim represents specific mercy toward believers. This distinction teaches that divine justice operates on two levels: natural law and revealed guidance.

118.title: Manuscript page 118 — Surah Yāzdah
118.transliteration: Ulá'ik alládhín átaynáhum al-kitáb yafrḥún bi-má unzila ilayka wa-min al-ahzáb man yunkar ba'dah qul innamá umirt an a'bud Alláha wa-lá ushrik bih • Ilayh tadúun wa-huwa al-haqq ta'alá 'ammá yushrikun • Qul inna rabbee yaqdhif bi-al-haqq 'allám al-ghuyúb

119.title: Manuscript page 119 — Surah Yāzdah
119.transliteration: Qul inna Alláha lá yazlim mithqal dharrah wa-in taku hasanah yudá'ifhá wa-yu'ti min ladunhu ajran 'azímaan • Fa-kayf idha ji'ná min kulli ummah bi-shahíd wa-ji'ná bik 'alá há'ulá'i shahíd

120.annotations: Transcription in progress. This page has not yet been verified against the manuscript.

129.transliteration: Qul ámannä bi-Alláhi wa-má unzil 'alayna wa-má unzil 'alá ibrahím wa-isma'íl wa-ishaq wa-ya'qub wa-al-asbáth • Wa-má unzil 'alá músá wa-'ísá wa-má úti an-nabiyyun min rabbihim lá nurfarríq bayna aḥad minhum wa-naḥnu lahu muslimun

130.transliteration: Fa-in ámanú bi-mithli má ámantu bih fa-qadi ahtadu wa-in tawallaw fa-innamá hum fi shiqáq fa-sayakfíkahum Alláhu wa-huwa as-samí' al-'alím • Sibghat Alláhi wa-man aḥsan min Alláhi sibghah wa-naḥnu lahu 'ábidun

131.title: Manuscript page 131 — Surah Yāzdah
131.transliteration: Qul a-tuḥájjunna fi Alláhi wa-huwa rabbuna wa-rabbukum wa-lana a'máluna wa-lakum a'málukum wa-naḥnu lahu mukhliṣun • Am taqúlun inna ibrahím wa-isma'íl wa-ishaq wa-ya'qub wa-al-asbáth kanu húdan aw nasará qul a-antum a'lam am Alláhu
131.annotations: Transcription in progress. This page has not yet been verified against the manuscript.

132.title: Manuscript page 132 — Surah Yāzdah
132.transliteration: Balá man aslama wajhahu li-Alláhi wa-huwa muḥsin fa-lahu ajruhu 'ind rabbih wa-lá khawf 'alayhim wa-lá hum yaḥzanun • Wa-qálat al-yahúd wa-an-nasára naḥn abnáu Alláhi wa-ahíbbá'uh qul fa-lim yu'addhbikum bi-dhunúbikum bal antum bashar mimman khalaq

133.title: Manuscript page 133 — Surah Yāzdah
133.transliteration: Bal yu'adhdhib man yasháa wa-yarḥam man yasháa wa-li-Alláh mulk as-samawat wa-al-ard wa-má baynahuma wa-ilayh al-masír • Ya ahal al-kitáb qad já'akum rasúlna yubayyín lakum 'alá fatra min ar-rusul an taqúlu má já'ná min bashír wa-lá nadhír fa-qad já'akum bashír wa-nadhír wa-Alláhu 'alá kulli shay' qadír

144.title: Manuscript page 144 — Surah Yāzdah
144.transliteration: Má nansakh min áyah aw nunisihá na'ti bi-khayrin minhá aw mithlihá alam ta'lam anna Alláha 'alá kulli shay' qadír • Alam ta'lam anna Alláha lahu mulk as-samawat wa-al-ard wa-má lakum min dun Alláhi min walíy wa-lá nasír • Am turídun an tas'alú rasúlakum kamá su'ila músá min qabl wa-man yatabaddal al-kufr bi-al-íman fa-qad dálla sawá' as-sabíl
